title: DeepSeek API Pricing 2026: Models, Cache, Output
summary: DeepSeek API pricing uses a pay-per-token model with no monthly subscriptions.
body_markdown:
## DeepSeek API pricing today, plan by plan


### DeepSeek V4 model pricing comparison table


To see what moves a bill, set the two current models side by side on the dimensions in the table below.


Treat those cells as questions to settle before you budget, because DeepSeek has revised the page's prices during 2026.

*Prices and plan limits checked against[docs.claude.com](https://docs.claude.com/en/docs/about-claude/models/overview) and[claude.com](https://claude.com/pricing) and[openai.com](https://openai.com/chatgpt/pricing) and[gemini.google](https://gemini.google/subscriptions) on October 20, 2026.*


Read the table in two passes. First compare the cache-hit and cache-miss rows, since DeepSeek bills a repeated prompt prefix at the lower rate. Then compare off-peak and peak, because DeepSeek prices a batch job that can wait differently from one that can't.


Choosing between the two starts with images:[deepseek](https://api-docs.deepseek.com/quick_start/pricing.md) -flash is the fast, cheap option and accepts images, while V4-Pro is the higher-capability model and takes text only. If your workload sends screenshots or scanned pages, that settles the choice before price does.


If it's text only, the question becomes whether Pro's extra capability saves you retries, since a failed run costs the same as a successful one.


### DeepSeek peak and off-peak API rates


DeepSeek charges one rate during its peak window and a lower rate outside it. Peak hours are 01:00 - 04:00 and 06:00 - 10:00 UTC, Monday through Friday, excluding Chinese public holidays. Read them there before you schedule anything.


The same goes for the size of the discount. Off-peak rates are half of peak across the board, and the one off-peak figure used below is a $0.003 cache hit.


A batch job gets the lower rate only if it runs inside the off-peak window, so a job that drifts past the boundary bills at peak.


The $0.30 miss and $0.006 hit in the sections below are peak rates. The $3.96 output rate for V4-Pro is the peak rate; off-peak is $1.98.


### Free credits, top-ups and how billing works


You add funds first, and each request draws them down; billing is prepaid usage. I have no confirmed figure for any free credit, so don't budget around one.


Top up in amounts you can afford to lose to a runaway loop.


Wire the balance into a check that tells you when it drops, whether that's a script or a flow in[Activepieces](https://www.activepieces.com/) , which allows unlimited flows on every plan including free, that pings you.
